title: κ = 9.93946061393808e-4: clean-checkout replay successor for frozen #388
body:
κ = 9.93946061393808e-4 (unchanged reproducibility correction for frozen #388)

This is a new corrective package; #388 remains frozen at `783e019de2a27c30cd0dc858f4611f044e6fe77a`.

A clean archive of #388 exposed three manifest entries for ignored logs and a verifier scope gap. This successor stores every required artifact in Git and freshly checks the omitted obligations: source reconstruction, record export, both reflected frame ledgers, arbitrary dirty signed restoration, local/reflected rational charts, seven-stage lowering and idle links, all F₂ columns, all 120 rational route programs, the finite bill, and exact assembly from fresh complex outputs.

Evidence from the committed archive:

- CPython 3.12: 17 stages, observed exit 0; verification SHA256 `eabdf0cd51580aad32635f3f1e0c9b9798ed863a5ab80a10e8c8a844b3bc48d4`.
- CPython 3.11: 17 stages, observed exit 0; verification SHA256 `9a0e9dde9626c0fe06e5b09c45ff4150a14284ebf616d1489e68fd7d16ff6879`.
- Both assemblies SHA256 `71f37b693ca910380180aeeab06420f66aa674da5e4faa758f848cc592eef593`.
- Package manifest SHA256 `4d64d07043c40e84bb30913e580048a2b34b50f58f0f2b5813487771e2e34820`.

The exact κ and finite coefficient are unchanged. Run `python3 -B verify.py <package> --work <fresh-output>` with Python 3.11+, numpy, sympy, and mpmath. The package retains source provenance, licenses, and AI disclosures. It remains conditional on the inherited compiler, bank/routing, precision/recovery, row, and analytic interfaces; it is not a Lean multiplication proof.
